intro: One glass of sweetened teh O ais has about 90 kcal (estimate). Almost all the calories come from the sugar or sugar syrup added.

variants.name: Teh O ais kurang manis (less sweet)

diet: Yes, but know that these 90 kcal are all from sugar. It doesn't fill you up at all. Two glasses a day is almost 200 kcal you could easily save. The easiest way is to cut the sweetness bit by bit.
tips: Start with 'kurang manis' for a week or two, then try 'kosong'.
Ask for more ice so it doesn't taste too strong with less sugar.
Avoid the jumbo glass or big plastic bag, pick a normal glass.

swap.name: Teh O ais kosong
swap.why: You still get the tea taste and the cold refreshment, with almost zero calories.

faq.q: Does teh O ais kosong have any taste?
faq.a: It has a slightly bitter tea taste. Most people get used to it within 1-2 weeks once their taste buds adjust.

faq.q: Is teh O good for hydration?
faq.a: It's still a fluid, but it has caffeine. Better to alternate with plain water throughout the day.

faq.q: Why is shop teh O sweeter than homemade?
faq.a: Shops usually use thick cooked sugar syrup. One ladle can equal 2-3 teaspoons of sugar.
